description: A server entry point for a Remix application handling HTTP requests and responses, with special handling for bots and browser clients, utilizing streaming server-side rendering.

methods.name: handleRequest
methods.description: Main handler for incoming HTTP requests, sets headers, distinguishes between bot and browser agents, and routes to respective handlers.

methods.name: handleBotRequest
methods.description: Handles server-side rendering stream when request comes from a bot, resolving the Response with rendered HTML stream.

methods.name: handleBrowserRequest
methods.description: Handles server-side rendering stream for browser requests, resolving the Response with rendered HTML stream.
